doom.name: Doom Brown + Natural Green accents + desaturated + gray
doom.description: 32 brown + 32 green accent ramps with good banding, 128 desaturated regulars, 64 gray

quantization.note: LUT encodes RGB 32^3 -> nearest palette index via brute search in palette.js

banding.note: When authentic=true, floor(color*bandLevels)/bandLevels — visible on accent ramps

docs.paletteStyle: Enum for palette generation — doom is new 2-accents layout
docs.authentic: When true, enable retro palette quantization + banding
docs.bandLevels: Number of color bands for authentic mode — lower = more retro, see accent ramps break into steps
docs.accentRamps: Array of 2 accent color ramps with good gradients/banding. Configurable per level/architecture later. For now brown + natural green.
docs.accentRamps.1.from: Start of green ramp — natural dark forest
docs.accentRamps.1.to: End of green ramp — sage light
docs.regularColors: Desaturated variations of regular colours — not too saturated
docs.customColors: Per-index overrides as map { "0": [R,G,B] } — click swatch in editor

paletteStyle.desc: Chooses how palette is generated — doom is new 2-accent layout
